notes: Responsive mobile shell: off-canvas navigation, tap-outside close, full-width content/drawers, responsive cards/forms/tables across React pages.
Redesigned React Storage uses storage cards and drill-in drawers instead of rendering every container on the main page.
Firearm drawer adds manufacturer profile/logo, compatible ammunition totals/products, Barrel Length and Sights.
Firearm gallery adds navigation, upload, set-primary, delete and lightbox controls.
Firearm editor adds Action, Finish, Barrel Length and Sights.
React Settings adds branding, reserve-target and manufacturer administration.
Dark-mode button colors are normalized globally.
Ammunition caliber filter now shows only calibers with quantity on hand.
